polityNote: Venezuela (Estados Unidos de Venezuela; República de Venezuela; República Bolivariana from 1999). The Guayana Esequiba claim is not administered and has no NE atom. From 1909-08-05 (constitution of 5 August 1909, twenty states, two federal territories and the Federal District): states untouched by the 1917/1933 Aragua–Carabobo–Guárico adjustments, by the 1941 Colombian treaty, by the 1995 Bolívar–Delta Amacuro annexation and by Cubagua are drawn from that day; the others stay unresolved until the change that gives them the atom's line.
